title: Canonical Owner Approval Contract
description: A canonical owner decision about ONE exact skill candidate (spec MAWS-SII-TARGET-SPEC-001 v0.2.0, slice S8, spec sections 12.3/13.4). The approval names the skill, the decision, the time and the exact candidate content digest it approves, and it carries a signature by a key published in the canonical owner authority anchor. The signature is what makes the approval an approval: an approver name and a decision reference without a valid signature are caller input and authorise nothing. Approval != Grant: a valid approval is a required gate of the promotion chain, never a permission and never an authority grant.

decision_ref.description: The identifier of the owner decision this approval carries. It is a signed claim, not an authority: only the signature makes it binding.

candidate_digest.description: The exact candidate content this approval approves. Any content change invalidates the approval.

key_id.description: The key in the canonical owner authority anchor that signed this approval.

value.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the approval body (every field except the signature envelope).
